en.title: About The Idea Machine — How the Random Idea Generator Works
en.description: How The Idea Machine turns three random reels into a side project or hackathon idea, what its two modes do, and answers to common questions about picking what to build.
en.intro: The Idea Machine is a free random idea generator for side projects and hackathons. Each roll combines three reels into one idea. Product mode mixes a space in human life, a product form and a twist. Hackathon mode mixes a topic, a piece of tech and a twist, sized for a weekend. Each mode has over 1,000,000 combinations, in English and Chinese.
en.belief: Built on a simple belief: good ideas often begin with an unlikely combination — and a little serendipity.
how: Press Roll. The three reels each land on one item.
Lock any reel you want to keep, then roll again to change only the others. At a hackathon, lock your theme or a sponsor's tech.
Browse a reel to pick an item yourself, or nudge it with the scroll wheel, a drag or the arrow keys.
Copy prompt hands the idea to ChatGPT, Claude or any AI assistant, which pitches three ways to build it. In Hackathon mode it also suggests the demo moment and scopes your pick for 24 hours.
Save image makes a shareable card, and every idea has its own link.

faq.q: How do I come up with a hackathon idea?
faq.a: Start from the hackathon's theme or a sponsor's tech, lock that reel in Hackathon mode, and roll the other two until a combination makes you laugh or say "wait, that could work." Then test it against one question: can you show it working in a two-minute demo?

faq.q: How big should a hackathon project be?
faq.a: Small enough to finish one complete, demoable flow in the time you have, usually 24 to 48 hours. Pick the one moment you want judges to see and build only what that moment needs. Hackathon mode's Copy prompt asks your AI assistant to scope the idea for 24 hours.

faq.q: How is this different from asking ChatGPT for an idea?
faq.a: Ask an AI assistant for an idea with no input and you tend to get the same safe suggestions. The Idea Machine starts from three random, hand-picked words, so you get combinations you wouldn't think to ask for. Copy prompt then hands them to your assistant to develop.

No, and they're not meant to be. The Idea Machine sparks ideas rather than judging them. Treat a roll as a prompt: if it reminds you of a problem you or people you know actually have, that's the idea worth digging into.

faq.q: Is it free, and can I use the ideas?
faq.a: Yes. It's free, needs no sign-up and runs in your browser. Any idea you roll is yours to build, sell or share, with no credit needed. The code and every idea list are open source under the MIT license on GitHub.

zh.title: 关于点子机 — 随机点子生成器是怎么运作的
zh.description: 点子机如何把三个随机转轮组合成一个副业项目或黑客松点子，介绍两种模式，并解答常见问题。
zh.intro: The Idea Machine（点子机）是一个免费的随机点子生成器，适合找副业项目和黑客松点子。每摇一次，三个转轮组合成一个点子。产品模式组合一个生活场景、一种产品形态和一个转折；黑客松模式组合一个题材、一项技术和一个转折，大小正好一个周末做完。每个模式都有超过一百万种组合，支持中英文。
zh.belief: 好点子很少是想出来的，多半是撞出来的。
how: 按下「摇一摇」，三个转轮各停在一项上。
锁住想保留的转轮，再摇一次，只换其余的。参加黑客松时，可以锁住主题或赞助商的技术。
也可以浏览某个转轮亲自挑选，或用滚轮、拖动、方向键微调。
「复制提示词」会把点子交给 ChatGPT、Claude 等 AI 助手，让它给出三种做法；黑客松模式还会给出演示亮点，并把选中的点子规划成 24 小时能做完的版本。
「保存图片」生成一张可分享的卡片，每个点子也都有自己的链接。

faq.q: 怎么想出一个黑客松点子？
faq.a: 从黑客松的主题或赞助商的技术出发，在黑客松模式里锁住那个转轮，再摇另外两个，直到某个组合让你笑出来，或者让你说「等等，这个能做」。然后用一个问题检验它：你能在两分钟的演示里让它跑起来吗？

faq.q: 黑客松项目应该做多大？
faq.a: 小到能在有限时间（通常 24 到 48 小时）里完成一条完整、可演示的流程。先想好最想让评委看到的那一刻，只做那一刻需要的部分。黑客松模式的「复制提示词」会请 AI 助手按 24 小时来规划。

faq.q: 这和直接问 ChatGPT 要点子有什么不同？
faq.a: 什么都不给就问 AI 要点子，往往只会得到差不多的稳妥建议。点子机从三个随机、人工挑选的词出发，组合出你想不到去问的方向；「复制提示词」再把它们交给你的 AI 助手去展开。
没有，也不打算验证。点子机负责激发灵感，而不是评判点子。把摇出的结果当作一个提示：如果它让你想起自己或身边人真实遇到的问题，那才是值得深挖的点子。

faq.q: 免费吗？点子可以拿去用吗？
faq.a: 免费，不用注册，打开浏览器就能用。摇出的点子随你去做、去卖、去分享，不用署名。代码和所有点子清单都以 MIT 协议在 GitHub 开源。
